item.text: {"iteration":7,"pcvs":[{"name":"query_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim","rationale":"Exposes query-row work directly, including output projection and attention row overhead."},{"name":"attention_tail_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * ((hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) % 16)","rationale":"Captures attention remainder work, which was absent from the previous candidate and matters especially for short cross-attention contexts."},{"name":"rotary_elements","expression":"hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0","rationale":"Captures additional elementwise work on the rotary path."},{"name":"uses_rotary","expression":"int(rotary_emb is not None)","rationale":"Captures fixed rotary dispatch and allocation overhead."}],"hypothesis":"The best previous remainder model combined query and context lengths, obscuring query-row costs. Using query size directly alongside attention tails and both rotary terms should explain more of the cross-attention residual while preserving self-attention scaling."}
